Under tsadi sits a horizontally aligned pair of distinct stamped punch dots with a distinct central separation notch at y=114. Confirmed as stamped Tsere U+05B5.

The lower horizontal mass of the sin shows physical contact with the horizontal punch of the tsere vowel (height 34 px vs ordinary 28 px base).
